description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for displaying a list of medical records in a mobile application. It includes a stateful widget MedicalRecordsScreen that manages fetching and displaying medical records, along with related sub-widgets and UI elements.

classes.name: MedicalRecordsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of medical records, handles initialization, refreshing, and UI interactions.

classes.name: _MedicalRecordsScreenState
classes.description: State class for MedicalRecordsScreen, manages fetching data and user interactions.

classes.name: _RecordTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays individual medical record information in a ListTile.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers data fetch after the first frame.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the list of medical records.

methods.name: _createStub
methods.description: Shows a snackbar indicating that record creation is coming soon.

methods.name: build (for MedicalRecordsScreen)
methods.description: Builds the UI for the medical records list, handling loading, error, and empty states.

methods.name: build (for _RecordTile)
methods.description: Builds the UI for a single medical record tile.
